label: lehome-rollout-builder
on-start: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git docker.io && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && service docker start && for i in $(seq 1 90); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'dockerd failed to start' >&2; exit 1; }; git clone --depth 1 --branch ${BUILD_BRANCH:-ryanjin333/vast-rollout} https://github.com/ryanjin333/lehome-challenge.git /tmp/src && cd /tmp/src/docker/rollout && IMAGE_TAG=${IMAGE_TAG:-ghcr.io/ryanjin333/lehome-rollout:latest} PUSH=1 REGISTRY_HOST=${REGISTRY_HOST:-ghcr.io} REGISTRY_USER=${REGISTRY_USER:-ryanjin333} REGISTRY_TOKEN=${REGISTRY_TOKEN} ./build.sh 2>&1 | tee /var/log/image-build.log && echo 'BUILD_DONE: image build and push finished' || echo 'BUILD_FAILED: image build or push failed'
